extracted.intended_audience: trademark examiners, IP professionals, logo/mark designers and search indexers who use the Vienna Classification
extracted.subtask_description: Apply the Vienna Classification (7th Edition) taxonomy to classify figurative elements in marks and designs; identify the appropriate category/division/section for a given figurative element or device.

rubrics_metrics.name: 16.3 PHOTOGRAPHY, CINEMATOGRAPHY, OPTICS
rubrics_metrics.description: Category grouping photographic or cinematographic apparatus, projection apparatus and lanterns; includes video cameras, traffic radars and photographic lenses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section: 16.3.1 Photographic or cinematographic apparatus, projection apparatus and lanterns. Auxiliary sections include items such as iris diaphragms (A 16.3.3) and films/containers for films (A 16.3.5). Subsections enumerate other apparatus (16.3.11), spectacles and frames (16.3.13), binoculars/telescopes/microscopes (16.3.15), magnifying glasses with handle (16.3.17), optical lenses/contact/spectacle lenses (16.3.19), and other optical apparatus (16.3.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17 HOROLOGICAL INSTRUMENTS, JEWELRY, WEIGHTS AND MEASURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level division covering time-measuring instruments, jewelry, balances/weights and measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains divisions 17.1 (horological/time-measuring), 17.2 (jewelry), 17.3 (balances/weights) and 17.5 (measures). Each division has principal and auxiliary sections for specific types (e.g., sundials, pearls, scales, measuring instruments).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.1 HOROLOGICAL AND OTHER TIME-MEASURING INSTRUMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Horological instruments including watches, clocks and other time-measuring devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 17.1.1 (Horological instruments). Specific entries include sundials (17.1.17), sandglasses (17.1.19), other time-measuring instruments (17.1.25). Auxiliary sections cover circular and non-circular dials (A 17.1.2, A 17.1.3), hands (A 17.1.5), other parts (A 17.1.6), watches (A 17.1.7), chronometers (A 17.1.8), clocks/alarm clocks (A 17.1.9) and watch bracelets (A 17.1.13). Note exclusions: dials of measuring instruments other than horological are in 17.5.1; spiral springs in 14.3.21.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.2 JEWELRY
rubrics_metrics.description: Precious stones, pearls and various types of jewelry such as necklaces, bracelets and rings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include precious stones (17.2.1), pearls (17.2.5), necklaces/bracelets/chains (17.2.13), rings/wedding rings (17.2.17) and other jewels (17.2.25). Notes mention inclusions like cuff links, tie pins and hat pins. Auxiliary sections include precious stones cut in facets (A 17.2.2), other representations (A 17.2.4) and pearls/precious stones in an oyster (A 17.2.6).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.3 BALANCES, WEIGHTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Balances and weights, and parts and types thereof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 17.3.1 (Balances, weights). Auxiliary sections include balances with two trays (A 17.3.2), other balances (A 17.3.3), parts of balances (A 17.3.5) and weights (17.3.11).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.5 MEASURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruments and devices for measurement and calculating instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 17.5.1 (Measures) — note excludes time-measuring instruments (17.1) and balances/weights (17.3). Auxiliary sections (A 17.5.2 etc.) list instruments for linear measurement (yardsticks, rulers, tape measures, gauges, calipers, micrometers), slide rules, abacuses, compasses for draftsmen, squares, French curves, T-squares, thermometers (A 17.5.19), mariners' compasses (A 17.5.21) and other measuring instruments (A 17.5.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18 TRANSPORT, EQUIPMENT FOR ANIMALS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering land, water, aerial/space vehicles and equipment for animals, plus traffic signs and indicator boards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subdivisions include 18.1 (land vehicles), 18.2 (equipment for animals), 18.3 (vehicles for use on water/amphibious), 18.4 (anchors; buoys or lifebelts), 18.5 (aerial or space vehicles), and 18.7 (traffic signs/indicator boards). Notes specify inclusions/exclusions (e.g., cable cars included; escalators and conveyor belts excluded).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.1 LAND VEHICLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Vehicles propelled by human/animal power, motor vehicles, rail vehicles and other land vehicles, plus parts and stylized representations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 18.1.1 (vehicles propelled by human/animal power, bicycles, motorcycles), 18.1.7 (motor road vehicles), 18.1.11 (rail vehicles/trains/tramcars), 18.1.14 (other land vehicles). Also lists parts like tyres, axles, steering wheels, radiators, exhausts (18.1.21), stylized land vehicles (18.1.23) and other means of transport not in 18.3/18.5 (18.1.25). Auxiliary sections include chariots (A 18.1.2/A 18.1.3), motor cars (A 18.1.8), lorries/coaches/tractors (A 18.1.9), locomotives (A 18.1.12), road rollers (A 18.1.15), lifts/lift trucks (A 18.1.16), toboggans/sledges (A 18.1.17), caravans (A 18.1.18), perambulators/caddies/scooters (A 18.1.19) and wheelchairs (A 18.1.20).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.2 EQUIPMENT FOR ANIMALS
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment for horses, dogs, cats and other animals (horseshoes singled out).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section: 18.2.1 Horseshoes (note: equipment for horses except 18.2.1). Other principal subsections include 18.2.7, 18.2.17 (equipment for dogs and cats) and 18.2.25 (equipment for other animals). Auxiliary sections: stirrups/spurs (A 18.2.7), harness (A 18.2.11), saddles (A 18.2.13), whips/hunting crops (A 18.2.15), collars/leashes for dogs/cats (A 18.2.18).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.3 VEHICLES FOR USE ON WATER AND AMPHIBIOUS VEHICLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Rowing boats, canoes, sailing boats, motor boats, ships and associated parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include small craft (18.3.1), sailing boats (18.3.2), motor boats and ships (18.3.14), sails/portholes/oars (18.3.21), fanciful/stylized boats (18.3.23), and other means of transport on water (18.3.25). Notes include amphibious vehicles and air-cushion vehicles; auxiliary sections list types like Viking boats, clippers, liners, submarines and ship funnels (A 18.3.x).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.4 ANCHORS; BUOYS OR LIFEBELTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Anchors, buoys, lifebelts and associated representations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 18.4.1 (Anchors; buoys or lifebelts). Auxiliary sections include anchors/crossed anchors (A 18.4.2/A 18.4.3) and buoys or lifebelts (A 18.4.11).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.5 AERIAL OR SPACE VEHICLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Aeroplanes, helicopters, balloons, kites, parachutes, rockets, satellites and other aerial vehicles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 18.5.1 (Aeroplanes, helicopters) — includes parts of aeroplanes (tails, wings, cockpits). Not including propellers (15.1.13). Other entries: 18.5.5 (balloons, kites, gliders, parachutes), 18.5.10 (space rockets, capsules, artificial satellites). Auxiliary sections cover stylized aeroplanes (A 18.5.3) and balloon/ kite variants (A 18.5.6–A 18.5.8).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.7 TRAFFIC SIGNS AND INDICATOR BOARDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Road, railway, water and air traffic signs and indicator boards, and related signalling devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 18.7.1 (road or railway traffic signs), 18.7.22 (water or air traffic signs). Auxiliary sections list direction indicators, business name plates and street plates (A 18.7.9), traffic lights (A 18.7.11), milestones (A 18.7.13), other road/rail signs (A 18.7.20), semaphores (A 18.7.19) and signal buoys (A 18.7.23).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19 CONTAINERS AND PACKING, REPRESENTATIONS OF MISCELLANEOUS PRODUCTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Large/small containers, bottles, amphorae, coffins, laboratory receptacles, medical apparatus and representations of miscellaneous products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divisions include 19.1 (large containers), 19.3 (small containers), 19.7 (bottles/flasks), 19.8 (parts/accessories of bottles), 19.9 (amphorae/pitchers/vases/flower pots), 19.10 (coffins/funerary urns), 19.11 (receptacles for laboratory use/pharmacy), 19.13 (medical/surgical apparatus), and 19.19 (representations of miscellaneous products). Each principal section enumerates subtypes (e.g., 19.1.1 large cylindrical containers, 19.3.1 small cylindrical containers, 19.7.1 bottles with circular cross section, 19.8.1 parts or accessories of bottles). Notes mark exclusions (e.g., hermetically sealed tins classified elsewhere) and inclusions (pouring devices, teats for baby bottles). Auxiliary sections list specific variants (barrels, sacks, piggy banks, tubes with wrappers, tube pinched at one end, bottle necks, stoppers, sealing capsules, mortars, test tubes, hypodermic syringes, prostheses, condoms, plasters, stethoscopes, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.1 LARGE CONTAINERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Large cylindrical/elliptical/non-cylindrical containers such as tanks, gas bottles, barrels, packing cases and crates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal entries: 19.1.1, 19.1.3, 19.1.4; auxiliary sections cover barrels lying horizontally/standing upright/viewed from the front (A 19.1.5–A 19.1.8), vats, wooden buckets, milking pails, large sacks for transporting merchandise (A 19.1.11), baskets including dossers and portable bottle crates (A 19.1.12) and other large containers (A 19.1.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.3 SMALL CONTAINERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Small cylindrical/non-cylindrical containers, coffee/tea pods, letter boxes, sachets and related small receptacles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 19.3.1, 19.3.3, 19.3.6. Auxiliary entries include letter boxes, sachets (A 19.3.4/A 19.3.5), piggy banks/money boxes (A 19.3.8/A 19.3.9), tubes or bottles with wrappers (A 19.3.15), tubes pinched at one end (A 19.3.21), paper/card prepared for assembling small containers (A 19.3.24) and other small containers (A 19.3.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.7 BOTTLES, FLASKS
rubrics_metrics.description: Bottles or flasks classified by horizontal cross section, shape, decorative forms, handles and other characteristics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 19.7.1 (circular/elliptical cross section), 19.7.2 (non-circular), 19.7.6 (bottles representing humans/animals/inanimate objects), 19.7.7 (bottles with handle), 19.7.25 (other bottles), 19.7.26 (feeding bottles). Auxiliary sections enumerate slender/squat/neckless/necked/various side profiles, inward-curving sides, bulging sides, conical shapes, ribs, surface relief, wicker casing, etc. (A 19.7.x).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.8 PARTS OR ACCESSORIES OF BOTTLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Necks, stoppers, sealing capsules and other parts/accessories of bottles (including pouring devices and teats for baby bottles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 19.8.1 (Parts or accessories of bottles). Notes exclude bottle openers and corkscrews (11.1.10). Auxiliary sections: bottle necks (A 19.8.2), stoppers/corks (A 19.8.5), sealing capsules (A 19.8.7) and other parts/accessories (A 19.8.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.9 AMPHORAE, PITCHERS, VASES, FLOWER POTS, FLOWER STANDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Amphorae, pitchers, decorative vases, flower pots and stands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 19.9.1 (Amphorae, pitchers, vases, flower pots, flower stands). Auxiliary sections distinguish amphorae with/without handles (A 19.9.2), decorative vases (A 19.9.3), flower pots/plant-growing pots (A 19.9.7) and flower stands/plant boxes (A 19.9.9).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.11 RECEPTACLES FOR LABORATORY USE AND FOR PHARMACY
rubrics_metrics.description: Mortars, retorts, balloon flasks, test tubes and other laboratory/pharmacy receptacles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal entries include mortars (19.11.1) and receptacles for laboratory use and pharmacy (19.11.4). Auxiliary sections: retorts spherical/ovoid (A 19.11.5), triangular retorts (A 19.11.7), spherical/triangular shaped receptacles (A 19.11.9/A 19.11.11), test tubes (A 19.11.13) and other receptacles (A 19.11.25). Note: mortars include kitchen mortars.

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.13 MEDICAL OR SURGICAL APPARATUS, INSTRUMENTS OR UTENSILS, PROSTHESES, MEDICINES
rubrics_metrics.description: Medical and surgical instruments and related items including syringes, prostheses, condoms, plasters and phials/capsules/pills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 19.13.1 groups medical or surgical apparatus, instruments or utensils, prostheses, medicines. Auxiliary entries list hypodermic syringes (A 19.13.3), massage apparatus (A 19.13.5), prostheses (A 19.13.7), condoms (A 19.13.13), plasters/bandages (A 19.13.15), phials/capsules/pills/suppositories (A 19.13.21), stethoscopes (A 19.13.22) and other medical apparatus (A 19.13.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 20 WRITING, DRAWING OR PAINTING MATERIALS, OFFICE REQUISITES, STATIONERY AND BOOKSELLERS' GOODS
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials and small office requisites for writing, drawing, painting; papers, documents and books/newspapers/bookbindings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divisions include 20.1 (writing/drawing/painting materials and small office requisites), 20.5 (papers/documents), 20.7 (books/bookbindings/newspapers). Notes list inclusions/exclusions (e.g., paper clips, pencil sharpeners, adhesive tape dispensers included; drawing pins excluded). Auxiliary sections list pencils, pens, paint brushes, artists' easels, clapperboards, embossed stamps, calendars, plans/diagrams, cards, envelopes, visiting cards, bank/credit cards, postage stamps and other paper items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 20.1 WRITING, DRAWING OR PAINTING MATERIALS, SMALL OFFICE REQUISITES
rubrics_metrics.description: Pencils, pens, paint brushes, artists' palette knives, easels and other small office requisites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 20.1.1 covers writing/drawing/painting materials (except specific exclusions 20.1.15 and 20.1.17). 20.1.15 covers easels/drawing boards/blackboards/slates; 20.1.17 covers other small office requisites. Notes highlight typical included items (paper clips, pencil sharpeners, adhesive tape dispensers, inking pads, toner cartridges) and exclusions (drawing pins classified elsewhere). Auxiliary sections enumerate pencils, fountain pens, felt-tip pens (A 20.1.3), paint brushes (A 20.1.5), painters' rollers, clapperboards (A 20.1.16) and embossed stamps/rubber stamps (A 20.1.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: 20.5 PAPERS, DOCUMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Parchments, calendars, handwritten/printed documents, plans, schematic drawings, cards, envelopes and paper rolls/wallpaper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include parchment with furled or fringed edges (20.5.1), calendars (20.5.3), other documents bearing texts/tables (20.5.5), plans/schematic drawings/diagrams (20.5.7), cards/card indexes/punched cards or tapes (20.5.11), envelopes (20.5.13), visiting cards (20.5.14), tie-on labels (20.5.15), bank/credit/identification cards (20.5.16), postage stamps (20.5.21), bank notes (20.5.23), crushed/crumpled/torn paper (20.5.24) and paper in rolls/wallpaper/other papers/documents (20.5.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 20.7 BOOKS, BOOKBINDINGS, NEWSPAPERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Books, magazines, newspapers, bookbindings and headings of periodicals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 20.7.1 covers books, magazines, newspapers, bookbindings and binders. Auxiliary sections include books/magazines/newspapers (A 20.7.2), bookbindings/binders (A 20.7.5) and headings of newspapers or magazines (A 20.7.7).

rubrics_metrics.name: 21 GAMES, TOYS, SPORTING ARTICLES, ROUNDABOUTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Packs of cards, playing pieces, puzzles, building games, sporting equipment, roundabouts and other toys.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divisions include 21.1 (games/toys) and 21.3 (sporting articles/roundabouts). Principal entries: packs/playing cards/figures on playing cards (21.1.1), playing dice/dominoes (21.1.9), draughtboards/chessboards/crosswords (21.1.11), chessmen (21.1.13), puzzles (21.1.14), building games (21.1.15), balloons (21.1.16), windmills (21.1.17), other games or toys (21.1.25). Sporting articles list footballs/shuttlecocks (21.3.1), skittles (21.3.3), rackets (21.3.5), golf clubs (21.3.7), skis/snowboards (21.3.9/21.3.10), dumb-bells/weights (21.3.13), cricket stumps/bats (21.3.14), fishing/hunting tackle (21.3.15), nets/goals/roundabouts/targets/table football/boxing gloves/billiard tables and cues (21.3.16–21.3.25). Notes indicate inclusions (e.g., gymnastic apparatus) and exclusions (certain arms in other divisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: 22 MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS AND THEIR ACCESSORIES, MUSIC ACCESSORIES, BELLS, PICTURES, SCULPTURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Musical instruments (percussion, wind, keyboard, stringed), accessories, bells, pictures and sculptures (human/animal/abstract).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divisions include 22.1 (musical instruments and accessories), 22.3 (bells) and 22.5 (pictures, sculptures). Principal entries: percussion instruments (22.1.1), wind instruments/whistles (22.1.5), keyboard instruments (22.1.10), stringed instruments (22.1.15), musical instrument accessories (22.1.21). Bells (22.3.1) and sculptures/pictures (22.5.1, 22.5.10 sculptures representing human beings, 22.5.19 sculptures representing animals) are enumerated; auxiliary sections detail variants (e.g., pipe organs A 22.1.11, tuning forks A 22.1.22, one/two/three/more bells).

rubrics_metrics.name: 22.1 MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS, MUSICAL INSTRUMENT ACCESSORIES, MUSIC ACCESSORIES
rubrics_metrics.description: Percussion, wind, keyboard, stringed instruments and associated accessories like drumsticks, bows, tuning forks and metronomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 22.1.1 percussion instruments; 22.1.5 wind instruments; 22.1.10 keyboard instruments; 22.1.15 stringed instruments; 22.1.21 accessories (drumsticks, bows, tuning forks, metronomes, music stands, special cases). Auxiliary entries include woodwind instruments/bagpipes (A 22.1.6–A 22.1.8), brass instruments, pipe organs (A 22.1.11), lyres/harps (A 22.1.16) and tuning forks (A 22.1.22).

rubrics_metrics.name: 22.3 BELLS
rubrics_metrics.description: Single and multiple bells, small globular bells and other bell variants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 22.3.1 Bells. Auxiliary sections enumerate one/two/three bells, more than three bells (A 22.3.5–A 22.3.8), and small globular bells (A 22.3.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: 22.5 PICTURES, SCULPTURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Representations of famous pictures, sculptures of humans, animals, groups and abstract sculptures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal entries: 22.5.1 Pictures, 22.5.10 Sculptures representing human beings, 22.5.19 Sculptures representing animals, 22.5.25 Other sculptures including abstract sculptures. Auxiliary sections include famous pictures (A 22.5.3), sculptures representing a woman/man/child/group (A 22.5.12–A 22.5.15) and equestrian sculptures (A 22.5.17).

rubrics_metrics.name: 23 ARMS, AMMUNITION, ARMOUR
rubrics_metrics.description: Weapons not being firearms, firearms/ammunition/explosives, and armour (including parts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top-level division 23 with sub-divisions 23.1 (side arms/other weapons), 23.3 (firearms, ammunition, explosives) and 23.5 (armour). Principal entries: side arms/spears/swords/daggers (23.1.1), bows/quivers (23.1.5), crossbows (23.1.7), other weapons (23.1.25). Firearms (23.3.1) and ammunition/explosives (23.3.10) have auxiliary listings for cannons/rocket launchers, rifles/machine guns, pistols/revolvers, cartridges, shells, grenades, etc. Armour (23.5.1) and auxiliary sections cover helmets and other parts of armour.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24 HERALDRY, COINS, EMBLEMS, SYMBOLS
rubrics_metrics.description: Shields, seals/stamps, medals/coins/decorations, flags, crowns, emblems/insignia, crosses, arrows, and miscellaneous signs/notations/symbols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divisions include 24.1 (shields), 24.3 (seals/stamps), 24.5 (medals/coins/decorations/orders), 24.7 (flags), 24.9 (crowns/diadems), 24.11 (emblems/insignia), 24.13 (crosses), 24.15 (arrows), 24.17 (signs/notations/symbols). Each principal section enumerates detailed variants and auxiliary sections specify typologies (e.g., shields with figurative elements, seals circular/elliptical, medals with human heads or other figurative elements, flags in clusters or stylized forms, crowns closed/open/stylized, cross types). Notes call out exceptions and related classification cross-references.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.1 SHIELDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Shields classified by whether they contain figurative elements, inscriptions, geometrical figures, or are of unusual shapes; includes shields with supporters or surmounted elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: shields with neither figurative element nor inscription (24.1.1), shields with geometric figures/lines/partitions (24.1.3), shields containing other figurative elements or inscriptions (24.1.5 and 24.1.17). Auxiliary sections detail shields with heavenly bodies, human figures (A 24.1.7–A 24.1.10), plants, landscapes, manufactured articles, inscriptions and shields surmounted by figurative elements (A 24.1.11–A 24.1.20).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.3 SEALS, STAMPS
rubrics_metrics.description: Seals or stamps in various forms (attached/applied to documents, circular, elliptical, other shapes) and with different figurative content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 24.3.1 Seals or stamps. Auxiliary sections list seals/stamps attached to documents or ribbons, circular/elliptical/other forms (A 24.3.2–A 24.3.9), and stamps with representations of heavenly bodies, humans, animals, plants, landscapes, manufactured articles, geometrical figures, inscriptions and other figurative elements (A 24.3.11–A 24.3.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.5 MEDALS, COINS, DECORATIONS, ORDERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Single or multiple medals/coins and decorations/orders such as the Golden Fleece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include one medal/coin (24.5.1), two medals/coins (24.5.5), more than two medals/coins (24.5.7) and decorations/orders (24.5.20). Auxiliary sections cover medals/coins with human head representations (A 24.5.2–A 24.5.3) and specific decorations/orders (A 24.5.21 Golden Fleece, A 24.5.25 other decorations).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.7 FLAGS
rubrics_metrics.description: Single and multiple flags, flags in clusters, banderoles, stylized flags and flag shapes (triangular, rounded, swallow tail).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 24.7.1 One flag, 24.7.3 Two or more flags. Auxiliary sections include flags in clusters (A 24.7.5), flags in banderole form (A 24.7.11), several flags on same staff/cable (A 24.7.21), flags with tapered or rounded ends (A 24.7.13), triangular flags (A 24.7.15) and stylized flags (A 24.7.23).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.9 CROWNS, DIADEMS
rubrics_metrics.description: Crowns closed at the top, crowns open at the top, stylized/fanciful crowns and diadems, with auxiliary variants by number, ornamentation and accompanying elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 24.9.1 crowns closed at top, 24.9.2 crowns open at top, 24.9.3 stylized crowns, 24.9.4 diadems. Auxiliary sections enumerate one vs. two crowns, crowns with spheres on tips, battlement-like rims, crowns with three triangular points, crowns with various decorative motifs (A 24.9.5–A 24.9.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.11 EMBLEMS, INSIGNIA
rubrics_metrics.description: Roman ensigns, lictors’ fasces, sceptres, Mercury's staff, pastoral staffs, tridents, globes with crosses and other emblems or insignia.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 24.11.1 Roman ensigns/lichets' fasces/sceptres, 24.11.3 staves with wings, 24.11.5 crooked sticks/shepherds' crooks, 24.11.7 Neptune's tridents, 24.11.11 globes surmounted by a cross, 24.11.13 mitres, 24.11.14 Mercury's helmet, 24.11.15 Star of David, 24.11.16 horns of plenty, 24.11.17 Chinese symbol Ruyi, 24.11.18 recognized emblems/insignia, 24.11.21 braid/cockades and 24.11.25 other emblems. Notes indicate exclusions and related cross-references.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.13 CROSSES
rubrics_metrics.description: Various cross types (Greek, Latin, Lorraine, Maltese), crosses formed by inscriptions and other cross forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include Greek cross/St. Andrew's cross (24.13.1), Latin/tau cross (24.13.2), Cross of Lorraine/Papal cross (24.13.3), Maltese cross (24.13.4), crosses formed by inscriptions (24.13.5) and other crosses (24.13.25). Auxiliary sections specify crosses formed by intersecting lines, containing inscriptions or figurative elements, with rays or radiating lines, within circles/polygons/squares/rectangles, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.15 ARROWS
rubrics_metrics.description: Single and multiple arrows, arrowheads and arrows combined with inscriptions or figurative elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: 24.15.1 One arrow, 24.15.2 Two arrows, 24.15.3 More than two arrows. Auxiliary sections include arrowheads (24.15.21), arrows with barbs (A 24.15.5), arrows combined with letters/monograms/numerals (A 24.15.7), arrows forming circles/arcs/rings (A 24.15.13) and arrows formed by inscriptions (A 24.15.17). Note excludes arrowheads in the form of angles (26.3.23).

rubrics_metrics.name: 24.17 SIGNS, NOTATIONS, SYMBOLS
rubrics_metrics.description: Punctuation marks, mathematical signs, musical symbols, asterisks, at-symbol, currency symbols, recycling symbol, check signs, yin-yang, peace symbol, prohibition symbol and other signs/notations/symbols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: punctuation marks (24.17.1), asterisks (24.17.3), mathematical signs (24.17.5), musical symbols (24.17.10), astronomical/astrological signs and zodiac signs (24.17.15), at-symbol (24.17.17), currency symbols (24.17.18), recycling/check/yin-yang/peace/prohibition symbols (24.17.19–24.17.23). Auxiliary sections break down dots, exclamation/question marks, several mathematical signs, combinations with figures/letters, infinity symbol, treble clefs/notes and other related musical symbol permutations. Note: traffic signs not included here (see 18.7).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25 ORNAMENTAL MOTIFS, SURFACES OR BACKGROUNDS WITH ORNAMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Ornamental motifs, horizontally elongated ornamental surfaces, backgrounds divided into two or four, surfaces/backgrounds covered with repeated figures/inscriptions and other ornament-covered surfaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divisions include 25.1 (ornamental motifs), 25.3 (horizontally elongated ornamental surfaces), 25.5 (backgrounds divided into two or four), 25.7 (surfaces/backgrounds covered with repeated geometrical figures/figurative elements/inscriptions) and 25.12 (surfaces/backgrounds covered with other ornaments). Principal entries include frontispieces, ornamental bands/borders, banderoles/cartouches, frameworks/frames, labels/collarettes (25.1.x), elongated surfaces with varied edge shapes (25.3.x), backgrounds divided vertically/horizontally/diagonally/crosswise (25.5.x), surfaces covered with lozenges, squares, checks, polygons, circles/dots, hatched surfaces, repeated inscriptions, lines or bands and other repeated figurative elements (25.7.x).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.1 ORNAMENTAL MOTIFS
rubrics_metrics.description: Frontispieces, ornamental bands/borders, banderoles/cartouches, frameworks/frames and labels including bottle-neck labels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 25.1.1 frontispieces, 25.1.5 ornamental bands and borders, 25.1.6 banderoles/cartouches, 25.1.9 framework/frames, 25.1.15 labels/collarettes. Notes exclude plant-based ornament motifs (division 5.13) and elongated ornamental surfaces (division 25.3). Auxiliary sections subdivide complete frameworks, partial frames/embellishments and bottle collarettes/labels in band or ring form (A 25.1.x).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.3 HORIZONTALLY ELONGATED ORNAMENTAL SURFACES
rubrics_metrics.description: Elongated ornamental surfaces with various side shapes (convex/concave/entasis/polygonal) excluding elongated ellipses, triangles or quadrilaterals handled in other divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 25.3.1 horizontally elongated surfaces. Auxiliary sections enumerate elongated surfaces with two short sides convex/concave, one short side convex/concave, entasis on long sides, elongated polygons, elongated surfaces with concave/convex long sides, long sides consisting of arcs of circles or ellipses, and other elongated surfaces (A 25.3.x).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.5 BACKGROUNDS DIVIDED INTO TWO OR FOUR
rubrics_metrics.description: Backgrounds divided vertically, horizontally, diagonally or crosswise into two or four parts by lines, bands or areas of different appearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections: backgrounds divided into two vertically (25.5.1), horizontally (25.5.2), diagonally (25.5.3), divided crosswise vertically and horizontally (25.5.5) and crosswise diagonally (25.5.6). Also includes other backgrounds divided into two or four (25.5.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.7 SURFACES OR BACKGROUNDS COVERED WITH REPEATED GEOMETRICAL FIGURES, FIGURATIVE ELEMENTS OR INSCRIPTIONS
rubrics_metrics.description: Backgrounds covered with repeated geometric figures (lozenges, squares, checks, polygons, circles/dots), hatching or repeated inscriptions, lines or bands and other repeated ornament types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal Section 25.7.1 surfaces covered with repeated geometrical figures; 25.7.15 surfaces covered with hatching; 25.7.17 surfaces covered with a repeated inscription; 25.7.20 surfaces covered with lines or bands. Auxiliary sections specify lozenge shapes, squares/rectangles, check patterns, polygons, circles/ellipses, dots and other repeated geometrical figures (A 25.7.2–A 25.7.8), and straight/wavy/zigzag lines or bands (A 25.7.21–A 25.7.23). Notes exclude surfaces with scattered leaves/flowers (classified elsewhere).

rubrics_metrics.name: 25.12 SURFACES OR BACKGROUNDS COVERED WITH OTHER ORNAMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Surfaces or backgrounds covered with rays/radiating lines, moiré patterns or any other ornament.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal entries include surfaces covered with rays or radiating lines (25.12.1), moiré surfaces/backgrounds (25.12.3), and surfaces covered with any other ornament (25.12.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 26 GEOMETRICAL FIGURES AND SOLIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Geometrical figures and solids including circles/ellipses, segments/sectors, triangles, quadrilaterals, other polygons, juxtaposed/intersecting figures, lines and bands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes state geometric figures/solids may be composed of human beings, animals, plants or objects and exclude inscriptions forming geometrical figures (division 27.1). Divisions enumerated include 26.1 (circles/ellipses), 26.2 (segments/sectors), 26.3 (triangles/angle lines), 26.4 (quadrilaterals), 26.5 (other polygons), 26.7 (different geometrical figures juxtaposed/joined/intersecting), 26.11 (lines/bands) and 26.13 (other subdivisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: 26.1 CIRCLES, ELLIPSES
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification for circles and ellipses as geometric motifs or solids in figurative elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of Division 26: principal section 26.1 covers circles and ellipses; auxiliary sections (not shown here) would subdivide by specific arrangements or combinations with other elements. Note exclusions where inscriptions form geometric figures (division 27.1).
